description.fallback: Much to Polnareff, Joseph, and Kakyoin's surprise, the clone Polnareff had destroyed regenerates and forms more clones. Lovers says that he knows for a fact that he isn't strong or fast enough to hurt them, but he knows himself and he knows their weaknesses. Lovers forms more clones and neither Silver Chariot nor Hierophant Green can figure out who the real one is.

outro.fallback: When Steely Dan assures that Joseph's death is in only a matter of seconds, Jotaro replies that he doesn't know Kakyoin.
Indeed, Kakyoin was able to find out which Lovers was the real one by using his tentacles to check every one of them, allowing Hierophant Green to hit Lovers with an Emerald Splash.
